analystPrompt.title: Forward deployed analyst prompt
analystPrompt.description: Plain-English task for the Actor. Tell it what market, buyer, seller, evidence, and output you want.
analystPrompt.default: Find DACH space-tech companies likely to need thermal vacuum testing soon. Focus on evidence, urgency, price or budget clues, and next action for a forward deployed analyst.

nicheNeed.title: Niche thing to sell
nicheNeed.description: The specific product or service you want to find buyers for.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Optional search queries. Leave empty to use the default DACH space-tech query pack.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: How many Tavily results to request per search query.

maxLeads.title: Max ranked leads
maxLeads.description: Maximum number of scored leads to keep in the final report.

searchDepth.title: Tavily search depth
searchDepth.description: Use basic for cheaper/faster demo runs. Advanced costs more Tavily credits.

tavilyApiKey.title: Tavily API key
tavilyApiKey.description: Optional here if TAVILY_API_KEY is set as an Actor secret/environment variable.

n8nWebhookUrl.title: n8n webhook URL
n8nWebhookUrl.description: Optional. If provided, the Actor POSTs the ranked brief to this webhook.

dryRun.title: Dry run without Tavily
dryRun.description: Use sample results so the Actor can run without credentials.
